cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: So, Tim, we have to do a short summary of our work experience on a farm. TIM: Right.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: My farm was great, but arranging the work experience was hard.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: One problem was it was miles away and I don't drive.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: And also, I'd really wanted a placement for a month, but I could only get one for two

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: weeks. DIANA: I was lucky, the farmer let me stay on the farm so I didn't have to travel.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: But finding the right sort of farm to apply to wasn't easy.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: TIM: No, they don't seem to have websites, do they.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: I found mine through a friend of my mother's, but it wasn't easy. DIANA: No.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: TIM: My farm was mostly livestock, especially sheep.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: I really enjoyed helping out with them.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: I was up most of one night helping a sheep deliver a lamb ... DIANA: On your own?

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: TIM: No, the farmer was there, and he told me what to do.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: It wasn't a straightforward birth, but I managed.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: It was a great feeling to see the lamb stagger to its feet and start feeding almost

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: straightaway, and to know that it was OK. DIANA: Mm.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: TIM: Then another time a lamb had broken its leg, and they got the vet in to set it, and

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: he talked me through what he was doing. That was really useful.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: DIANA: Yes, my farm had sheep too.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: The farm was in a valley and they had a lowland breed called Suffolks, although the

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: farmer said they'd had other breeds in the past. TIM: So were they bred for their meat?

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: DIANA: Mostly, yes.

cues.speaker: DIANA
cues.text: They're quite big and solid.
